reason: All dependencies are published and were read: the biproduct definition and matrix calculus for morphisms between finite biproducts, uniqueness of representing objects, the Yoneda embedding, the enriched tensor/cotensor definition (V odot Y is exactly the tensor of Y by V, the k-linear category being enriched over finite-dimensional k-vector spaces), and the k-linear/abelian ambient items. The n-fold biproduct of Y represents Z |-> Hom_k(V,C(Y,Z)) for any chosen finite basis; a change of basis acts by an invertible scalar matrix, so the representing property produces a unique compatible comparison, and functoriality in V and in Y follows from the Yoneda assignment. Only finite data are used beyond the supplied biproducts.
